name: Control flags
decode: bit 0 = lock out updates; bit 1 = desired screen-lock state; bit 2 = apply screen-lock state; bit 3 = save measurement regime; bits 4 through 15 = reserved

name: Status flags
decode: bit 0 = online; bit 1 = urgent error; bit 2 = remote total changes disabled; bit 3 = current-loop alarm; bit 4 = digital device 0 alarm; bit 5 = digital output 1 alarm; bit 6 = digital output 2 alarm; bit 7 = digital output 3 alarm; bits 8 through 15 = reserved

name: Measured velocity
interpretation: IEEE-754 float32; units follow the measurement regime

name: Measured flow
interpretation: IEEE-754 float32; units follow the measurement regime

name: Operating status flags
decode: bit 0 = update forward flow total; bit 1 = update reverse flow total; bit 2 = update forward energy total; bit 3 = update reverse energy total; bit 4 = update damping; bits 5 through 28 = reserved; bit 29 = hot-probe fault; bit 30 = cold-probe fault; bit 31 = signal loss

name: Damping
interpretation: Low 7 bits are damping time; bit 7 selects damping type
